instructions_to_main_agent: Rebuild src/components/Admin.jsx into a categorized, high-end editorial admin dashboard UI.
Completely REMOVE ALL Hindi text. Translate all UI labels, helper texts, button captions, placeholders, and descriptions to crisp, professional English.
Implement categorized navigation using a side-nav layout on desktop (lg:grid lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8) and horizontal scrollable pill tabs on mobile.

Create a dedicated 'Branding & Logo' category tab allowing upload of custom website logo (stored in site.images.logo or site.branding.logo), with live preview, recommended 400x400 size hint, and option to reset to default logo.
Provide a dedicated top Action Bar / Sticky Save Toolbar that allows quick saving of Donate details or Site Content without searching for save buttons.
Maintain ALL existing test IDs (data-testid) for backwards compatibility and test suites:

- admin-page, admin-editor, admin-editor-heading, admin-login-form, admin-login-heading, admin-email-input, admin-password-input, admin-login-btn, admin-login-error, admin-logout-btn, admin-back-home-btn

- admin-contact-[key]-input, admin-focus-area-[N], admin-focus-area-[N]-icon-select, admin-focus-area-[N]-title-input, admin-focus-area-[N]-tagline-input, admin-focus-area-[N]-text-input, admin-add-focus-area-btn
Add new data-testid attributes for category tab navigation (e.g. admin-tab-[category_id]).
Ensure responsiveness on mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports with fluid scroll and clean touch targets.

design_rules: Do NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Do NOT center align the app container globally.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for UI icons — use lucide-react icons instead.
Every interaction must feature micro-animations (hover transitions, active press state, focus rings).
Use 2-3x generous spacing in cards and containers.
All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes.
